rows: Equipment: Transformer kiosks and rooms fitted with capacitors

Introduction
This form was prepared, reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators of all electricity distribution companies at the session of 17 March 2009
General condition of the transformer kiosk or room:
Cleanliness of the kiosk or room
Condition of the kiosk sheet metal or the room walls/ceiling/floor
Height of the kiosk/room floor level above ground level
Secure closing of the medium-voltage panel
Earthing connections in the kiosk or room
Medium-voltage disconnect switches and fuses (sound and suitable)
Low-voltage circuit breakers and fuses (sound and suitable)
End boxes of medium- and low-voltage cables
Numbers and designations of all cables
Burying all medium- and low-voltage cables (outside the kiosk/room)
Maintenance card for the kiosk or room
Single-line diagram for medium and low voltage
Automatic fire-fighting system for the transformer inside the kiosk/room
Make sure the kiosk or room door is securely closed according to the locking means (hasp, rose, bolt with padlock, lock)
Danger-of-death warning sign and emergency telephone numbers sticker on the outside of the kiosk/room, and the kiosk name or number
